skills.name: Release keystore management
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate keystore config (file.read gradle).
2. Never commit keystores (file.search gitignore).
3. Document key aliases and expiry (file.write).
4. Plan backup/rotation.
5. Verify signature config builds (gradle.exec).

skills.name: Version code strategy
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Pick a scheme: major*1e6+minor*1e3+patch (file.write doc).
2. Wire into build (file.patch version logic).
3. Ensure monotonic per-variant.
4. Verify with a build.
5. Record.

skills.name: R8 release pass
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Enable minify+shrinkResources (file.patch).
2. Collect missing-class errors from the build (gradle.exec).
3. Add targeted keeps (file.patch proguard-rules).
4. Test release on device (re.apk.install).
5. Record rules added.

skills.name: Crash reporting setup
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Choose provider (web.search).
2. Add SDK init (file.patch).
3. Map NPEs to source lines.
4. Verify a test crash appears.
5. Document access.

skills.name: Release notes flow
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Draft from git.log since last tag (cat_fs_release_notes).
2. Review with owner.
3. Attach to the tag/release.
4. Publish to store listing (user step).
5. Archive.

skills.name: Staged rollout planning
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Pick track/percentage (file.write plan).
2. Define halt criteria (crash rate threshold).
3. Monitor post-release metrics.
4. Halt/rollback drill.
5. Record.

skills.name: Release checklist
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Checklist file: version, signing, notes, QA signs (file.write).
2. Verify each before tag.
3. Tag and build (gradle.exec).
4. Archive artifacts.
5. Record.

skills.name: Release flavors
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Add staging flavor (file.patch).
2. Distinct applicationId suffix.
3. Endpoint sets per flavor (file.search BASE_URL).
4. Build both (gradle.exec).
5. Verify install side-by-side.

skills.name: Artifact verification
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Hash artifacts (python.run_file sha256).
2. Verify signature (re.apk.sign output/apksigner).
3. Check version metadata (re.apk.manifest).
4. Store hashes with release (file.write).
5. Record.

skills.name: Store listing prep
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Screenshots per device class (android_screenshot).
2. Descriptions and localized strings (file.write).
3. Data-safety forms mapping from manifest permissions (python.run_file).
4. Review policy compliance (web.search store policies).
5. Submit.

skills.name: In-app update flow
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Choose API (Play in-app updates or custom).
2. Wire the check (file.patch).
3. Handle flexible vs immediate modes.
4. Test with lower-version install.
5. Document.

skills.name: Release rollback plan
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Previous-good artifacts retained (file.list).
2. Server-side kill switches for risky features (remote config).
3. Store rollback steps (file.write).
4. Drill the rollback once.
5. Record.

skills.name: Fat JAR builds
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Configure shadow-style plugin or manual merge (file.patch build).
2. Handle service files merging.
3. Build (gradle.exec jar task).
4. Run with java.exec -jar to verify.
5. Record.

skills.name: JAR manifest attributes
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read current MANIFEST.MF.
2. Patch build to emit Main-Class (file.patch).
3. Verify executable jar (java.exec).
4. Note sealed/signed attrs if any.
5. Record.

skills.name: Windows launcher packaging
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Choose launcher tool (web.search launch4j).
2. Configure icon/version/heap (file.write config).
3. Build wrapper (process.exec).
4. Test launch on Windows.
5. Record.

skills.name: Debian packaging
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Write control/postinst per docs (file.write debian/).
2. dpkg-deb build (process.exec).
3. Install in a test container (process.exec docker).
4. Verify service entrypoints.
5. Record.

skills.name: RPM packaging
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Write spec file (file.write).
2. rpmbuild (process.exec).
3. Install-test in a container.
4. Verify scripts (pre/post).
5. Record.

skills.name: AppImage packaging
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Prepare AppDir layout (file.write).
2. appimagetool build (process.exec).
3. Test on clean system.
4. Verify desktop integration.
5. Record.

skills.name: MSI packaging
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Choose WiX (web.search docs).
2. Author component/feature XML (file.write).
3. Build MSI (process.exec candle/light).
4. Test install/upgrade/uninstall.
5. Record.

skills.name: NSIS packaging
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Author NSIS script (file.write).
2. Compile (process.exec makensis).
3. Test silent install flags.
4. Sign the installer (code signing notes).
5. Record.

skills.name: macOS packaging note
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Bundle structure: Contents/MacOS, Info.plist (file.write).
2. codesign steps (process.exec).
3. Notarization prerequisites (web.search).
4. Test on macOS (user step).
5. Record.

skills.name: Portable ZIP distribution
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Assemble runtime + app into a folder (process.exec).
2. Add launcher scripts (file.write).
3. Test on a clean machine/container.
4. Hash the artifact (python.run_file).
5. Record.

skills.name: Installer upgrade paths
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Matrix: old->new versions (file.write).
2. Run each upgrade in a VM/container.
3. Check data migration.
4. Fix migration bugs.
5. Record.

skills.name: Uninstaller completeness
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List created files/registry equivalents (python.run_file scan).
2. Add cleanup steps (installer config).
3. Test uninstall leaves nothing.
4. Record.
5. Verify in container.

skills.name: Desktop auto-update
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Choose framework (web.search electron-updater/squirrel equivalents).
2. Wire update check (file.patch).
3. Sign updates; verify signature check.
4. Test staged update path.
5. Record.

skills.name: Desktop crash reporting
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Integrate crash handler (file.patch).
2. Include stack + versions.
3. Upload policy + privacy note.
4. Test with a forced crash.
5. Record.

skills.name: Licensing flows
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Offline key validation approach (doc file.write).
2. Machine binding choices.
3. Grace periods.
4. Test tamper cases in lab.
5. Record decisions.

skills.name: Environment-specific builds
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Config injection per env (file.patch build).
2. No secrets in artifacts (python.run_file scan).
3. Build all envs (gradle.exec/make.exec).
4. Smoke each.
5. Record.

skills.name: Release train planning
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Cadence doc (file.write).
2. Freeze windows.
3. Hotfix path separate.
4. Calendar integration (user).
5. Record.

skills.name: Reproducible builds
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Pin toolchains/gradle wrapper (file.read/patch).
2. Avoid timestamps in artifacts (config).
3. Build twice; compare hashes (python.run_file).
4. Document deltas.
5. Record.

skills.name: Code signing artifacts
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Obtain cert (user).
2. Sign (process.exec per platform).
3. Verify signature (process.exec).
4. Publish hashes.
5. Record.
